    const fc = buildRevolve(x, z0, [[yc + .8, .05], [yc + .55, .2], [yc, .24], [yc - .7, .12]], sh(lv.b, -.04), 'paint', 16);
    fc.unshift(...boxFaces([[x - .04, yc + .2], [x + .04, yc + .2], [x + .04, yc - .2], [x - .04, yc - .2]], z0 + .15, zw, { top: '#6c737a', side: '#5a6067' }, { mat: 'metal' }));
    piece('engine', fc, { side: sd }) }
  if (t.boom) { const xb = t.boom.x * HS, yW = wingTE(xb), yT = yN - L, r0 = .32, z0 = wingZ(xb) - .25, hs = xb + .6;
    for (const sd of [1, -1]) { const fc = buildRevolve(sd * xb, z0, [[yW + 1.2, r0 * .9], [yW, r0], [yT + 2.2, r0 * .75], [yT, r0 * .5]], lv.b, 'paint', 16);
      const y0 = yT + 2.2, y1 = yT + .2, st = [0, 1].map(f => { const z = z0 + r0 + (t.H - z0 - r0) * f, yLE = y0 - f * 1.0, c = lerp(y0 - y1, (y0 - y1) * .6, f); return { z, yLE, yTE: yLE - c, t: c * .12 } });
      fc.push(...buildFin(st, lv.t).map(f => Object.assign(f, { P: f.P.map(q => [q[0] + sd * xb, q[1], q[2]]) })));
      piece('body2', fc, { side: sd }) }
    const zt = t.H - .2, yl = yT + 1.9; piece('stab', buildPlate([{ x: -hs, yLE: yl, yTE: yl - 1.3, z: zt, t: .12 }, { x: hs, yLE: yl, yTE: yl - 1.3, z: zt, t: .12 }], lv.t), { side: 0 }) }
  // ---- the low tailplanes ----
  if (!t.ttail && !t.boom) for (const sd of [1, -1]) {
    const yl = ofU(-.36), rc = .1 * L, tcc = .045 * L, sw = .07 * L, hs = HS * t.hs, a = yN - yl, r = F(a), z = r.zm + r.rv * .15, x0s = Math.max(.2, r.rs * .55);
    const st = [{ x: sd * x0s, yLE: yl, yTE: yl - rc, z, t: rc * .11 }, { x: sd * hs, yLE: yl - sw, yTE: yl - sw - tcc, z: z + (hs - x0s) * Math.tan(6 * D2R), t: tcc * .09 }];
    piece('stab', buildPlate(st, lv.w === 'allover' ? sh(lv.b, -.06) : '#e3e6e9'), { side: sd });
  }
  // ---- the gear: tyres (dark discs seen edge-on), legs, bogies ----
  const tyre = (x, y, r, w) => ({ tyre: 1, x, y, r, w });
  const gearPiece = (list, legs) => piece('gear', [], { tyres: list, legs });
  { const [tr, tw] = t.gear.tire, ymg = yC + x0 - t.wc * .55;
    for (const [gx, nAx] of t.gear.main) for (const sd of [1, -1]) {
      const T = [], X = sd * gx; for (let i = 0; i < nAx; i++) { const y = ymg + (nAx > 1 ? (i - (nAx - 1) / 2) * tr * 2.3 : 0); for (const dx of [-.42, .42]) T.push(tyre(X + dx * (tr * 1.25), y, tr, tw)) }
      const top = t.high ? t.zb + .6 : Math.min(wingZ(gx) - .2, t.zb + 1.4);
      gearPiece(T, [{ x: X, y: ymg, z0: tr * .9, z1: top, r: .17 }]);
    }
    if (t.gear.centre) { const T = [], y0 = ymg - 1.2; for (let i = 0; i < t.gear.centre; i++) for (const dx of [-.5, .5]) T.push(tyre(dx, y0 + (i - .5) * tr * 2.3, tr, tw)); gearPiece(T, [{ x: 0, y: y0, z0: tr, z1: t.zb + .3, r: .16 }]) }
    const nr = tr * .72; gearPiece([tyre(-.32, 0, nr, tw * .9), tyre(.32, 0, nr, tw * .9)], [{ x: 0, y: 0, z0: nr, z1: t.zb + .2, r: .1 }]);
    if (t.gear.sponson) for (const sd of [1, -1]) { const f = boxFaces([[sd * R * .7, ymg + 1.8], [sd * (R + .55), ymg + 1.5], [sd * (R + .55), ymg - 1.9], [sd * R * .7, ymg - 2.2]], t.zb + .1, t.zb + 1.2, { top: sh(lv.b, -.06), side: sh(lv.b, -.12) }, { mat: 'paint' }); piece('body2', f) }
  }
  // the piece's bounding values (local metres): yMax (the south edge), zMin (the lowest point), x range; the sort key comes from them
  for (const p of pieces) bounds(p);
  const info = { id, t, lv, L, R, HS, yN, yC, yTail: yN - L, wingLE, wingTE, wingZ, wingT, finTop: t.H, F, x0, band: BD, bandAt };
  return { pieces, info };
}

const HSP = [{ bw: .13, b: .36, body: 'tear', glass: 'bubble', gear: 'skid', tail: 'rotor' }, { bw: .15, b: .38, body: 'tear', glass: 'std', gear: 'skid', tail: 'rotor' },

// a body of revolution with elliptic sections: rings [y, rx, rz, colour?] round the axis (x0, ·, z0)
function revolveE(x0, z0, rings, col, mat, N) {
  const faces = []; N = N || 24;
  for (let k = 0; k < N; k++) { const t0 = k * TAU / N, t1 = t0 + TAU / N;
    for (let i = 0; i + 1 < rings.length; i++) { const [ya, xa, za, ca] = rings[i], [yb, xb, zb] = rings[i + 1];
      const P = [[x0 + xa * Math.cos(t0), ya, z0 + za * Math.sin(t0)], [x0 + xa * Math.cos(t1), ya, z0 + za * Math.sin(t1)], [x0 + xb * Math.cos(t1), yb, z0 + zb * Math.sin(t1)], [x0 + xb * Math.cos(t0), yb, z0 + zb * Math.sin(t0)]];
      const nn = th => nrm([Math.cos(th) / Math.max(.05, (xa + xb) / 2), -((xb - xa) / ((yb - ya) || 1e-6)) * 0, Math.sin(th) / Math.max(.05, (za + zb) / 2)]);
      faces.push(face(P, ca || col, mat, { g: [nn(t0), nn(t1)] })) } }
  return faces;
}
// heli(id, { spin }) → { pieces, info } — local metres, the origin at the mast's foot on the ground, the nose to the south (+y)
// the tandem-rotor transport (CH-47F): a long rounded box, the fuel pods along its lower sides, the low front pylon over the cockpit and
// the tall rear one with the two engines beside it, two rotors of 3 blades that overlap, four wheels, a blunt end with the ramp
function buildTandem(id, T, opt) {
  const L = T.L, pieces = [], piece = (kind, faces, extra) => { const p = Object.assign({ kind, faces, decor: [] }, extra || {}); pieces.push(p); return p };
  const zs = .55, hw = 1.3, hz = 1.35, zc = zs + hz, nx = L / 2, y1 = -L / 2, N = opt.lod ? 20 : 28, decor = [];
  const body = revolveE(0, zc, [[nx, .25, .3], [nx - .45, .95, 1.0], [nx - 1.5, 1.24, 1.3], [nx - 3, hw, hz], [y1 + 1.6, hw, hz], [y1 + .35, hw * .96, hz * .9], [y1, hw * .9, hz * .78]], T.main, 'paint', N);
  for (const sd of [1, -1]) body.push(...revolveE(sd * (hw + .18), zs + .55, [[nx - 4.2, .08, .1], [nx - 4.8, .32, .42], [y1 + 3.2, .34, .44], [y1 + 2.4, .1, .12]], sh(T.main, -.05), 'paint', 14));
  // the pylons: low in front, tall behind (its fin-like fairing), the engines either side of it
  body.push(...revolveE(0, zc + hz * .82, [[nx - 1.2, .1, .1], [nx - 1.7, .55, .45], [nx - 2.6, .5, .42], [nx - 3.4, .1, .1]], T.main, 'paint', 14));
  body.push(...buildFin([{ z: zc + hz * .6, yLE: y1 + 4.4, yTE: y1 + .2, t: 1.4 }, { z: zc + hz + 1.75, yLE: y1 + 2.4, yTE: y1 + .7, t: .8 }], T.main));
  for (const sd of [1, -1]) body.push(...revolveE(sd * 1.05, zc + hz + .35, [[y1 + 4.6, .1, .1], [y1 + 4.3, .38, .38], [y1 + 2.3, .4, .4], [y1 + 1.9, .22, .22]], sh(T.main, -.08), 'metal', 14));
  // the cockpit's glass: the windscreen and the side windows on the nose
  for (const sd of [1, -1]) { const P = [[sd * .1, nx - .55, zc + .55], [sd * .95, nx - 1.0, zc + .45], [sd * 1.2, nx - 1.75, zc + .4], [sd * 1.2, nx - 1.75, zc - .15], [sd * .95, nx - .95, zc - .1], [sd * .1, nx - .45, zc - .05]];
    decor.push(face(sd > 0 ? P : P.slice().reverse(), '#1d3346', 'glass', { n: [sd * .6, .5, .6], grad: ['#1a2c3d', '#57748c', '#c4d9e8'] })) }
  piece('body', body, { decor });
  { const r = .45, T4 = []; for (const y of [nx - 3.2, y1 + 3.6]) for (const sd of [1, -1]) T4.push({ tyre: 1, x: sd * 1.45, y, r, w: .3 }); piece('gear', [], { tyres: T4, legs: [] }) }
  // the rotors: the front hub over the cockpit, the rear one high on its pylon; parked blades or the discs
  const f = [], R2 = T.D / 2;
  for (const [yH, zt, a0] of [[nx - 2.2, zc + hz + .9, .3], [y1 + 1.6, zc + hz + 2.25, .9]]) {
    f.push(...vcyl(0, yH, .14, zt - .6, zt, '#3a3f45', 'metal', 10), ...vcyl(0, yH, .38, zt - .05, zt + .14, '#2a2e33', 'metal', 14));
    if (opt.spin) { const P = []; for (let i = 0; i < 36; i++) { const a = i / 36 * TAU; P.push([R2 * Math.cos(a), yH + R2 * Math.sin(a), zt + .06]) } f.push(face(P, '#d2dceb', 'glass', { n: [0, 0, 1], a: .18, ns: 1 })) }
    else for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { const a = a0 + i * TAU / 3, c = Math.cos(a), sn = Math.sin(a), w = .3; f.push(face([[-sn * w, yH + c * w, zt + .06], [R2 * c - sn * w, yH + R2 * sn + c * w, zt + .02], [R2 * c + sn * w, yH + R2 * sn - c * w, zt + .02], [sn * w, yH - c * w, zt + .06]], '#2c3036', 'metal', { n: [0, 0, 1], both: true })) } }
  piece('rotor', f);
  for (const p of pieces) bounds(p);
  return { pieces, info: { id, heli: true, t: Object.assign({ he: T.he, H: zc + hz + 2.4, zb: zs, fw: 2 * hw }, T), L, R: hw, yN: nx, HS: T.D / 2 + 6 } };
}
function buildHeli(id, opt) {
  opt = opt || {}; const T = HELI[id]; if (!T) throw new Error('A34: unknown helicopter ' + id);
  if ((HSP[T.k] || {}).body === 'tandem') return buildTandem(id, T, opt);
  const H = HSP[T.k] || HSP[0], L = T.L, b = L * H.b, bw = L * H.bw, hw = bw / 2, hz = bw * (H.hzk || .62), nx = H.body === 'sleek' ? b * .74 : b * .62, zs = H.gear === 'wheels' ? .7 : .55, zc = zs + hz;
  const yH = T.hub != null ? nx - T.hub * L : .05 * b;   // the rotor's hub: T.hub × L behind the nose (from the real overall length)
  const pieces = [], piece = (kind, faces, extra) => { const p = Object.assign({ kind, faces, decor: [] }, extra || {}); pieces.push(p); return p };
  const fb = H.body === 'box' ? [1, 1] : H.body === 'round' ? [1.06, 1] : [1, 1];
  // D‑281/D‑282 (the coordinator 18:2x): the H130's cabin is broad and glazed to the front (a blunt nose), the others come to a point
  const rings = H.front === 'blunt' ? [[nx, .36 * hw, .42 * hz], [nx - .04 * b, .8 * hw, .82 * hz], [nx - .15 * b, .97 * hw * fb[0], .98 * hz], [.05 * b, hw * fb[0], hz], [-.25 * b, .92 * hw, .9 * hz], [-.45 * b, .48 * hw, .58 * hz]]
    : [[nx, .06 * hw, .06 * hz], [nx - .07 * b, .5 * hw, .55 * hz], [nx - .22 * b, .88 * hw * fb[0], .93 * hz], [.05 * b, hw * fb[0], hz], [-.25 * b, .9 * hw, .88 * hz], [-.45 * b, .42 * hw, .5 * hz]];
  if (H.body === 'box') rings.splice(1, 1, [nx - .05 * b, .7 * hw, .7 * hz]);
  const body = revolveE(0, zc, rings, T.main, 'paint', opt.lod ? 20 : 28), decor = [];
  // the boom (its stripe in the accent), the fin with the tail rotor or the ducted fan, the tailplane
  const yB0 = -.3 * b, yB1 = nx - L, zb = zc + .25 * hz;   // the owner 16:46 (1): nose to tail = the real fuselage length L
  body.push(...revolveE(0, zb, (BM => [[yB0, BM[0][0] * hw, BM[0][1] * hw], [yB0 + (yB1 - yB0) * .45, BM[1][0] * hw, BM[1][1] * hw], [yB1 + .4, BM[2][0] * hw, BM[2][1] * hw], [yB1, BM[3][0] * hw, BM[3][1] * hw]])(H.boom || [[.42, .42], [.24, .24], [.14, .14], [.1, .1]]), T.main, 'paint', 12));
  const fin = [{ z: zb, yLE: yB1 + 1.1, yTE: yB1 - .1, t: .12 }, { z: zb + hz * 1.3, yLE: yB1 + .35, yTE: yB1 - .35, t: .08 }];
  body.push(...buildFin(fin.map(q => ({ z: q.z, yLE: q.yLE, yTE: q.yTE, t: H.tail === 'fen' ? .35 : q.t })), T.acc));
  const yS = yB1 + 1.4, sp = hw * 1.45; body.push(...buildPlate([{ x: -sp, yLE: yS, yTE: yS - .5, z: zb, t: .06 }, { x: sp, yLE: yS, yTE: yS - .5, z: zb, t: .06 }], T.acc));
  if (H.tail === 'fen') body.push(disc(-.19, yB1 + .3, zb + hz * .45, .32, '#1b1f24', 'matte', { n: [-1, 0, 0], both: true }));
  else { const tr = T.tr ? T.tr / 2 : L * .075, tx = -.18, tz = zb + hz * .5, n = H.tail === 'rotor4' ? 4 : 2;
    if (opt.spin) { const P = []; for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) { const a = i / 20 * TAU; P.push([tx, yB1 + .2 + tr * Math.cos(a), tz + tr * Math.sin(a)]) } body.push(face(P, '#cfd8e2', 'glass', { n: [-1, 0, 0], both: true, a: .25, ns: 1 })) }
    else for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const a = .5 + i * TAU / n; body.push(face([[tx, yB1 + .2, tz], [tx, yB1 + .2 + tr * Math.cos(a), tz + tr * Math.sin(a)], [tx, yB1 + .2 + tr * Math.cos(a + .14), tz + tr * Math.sin(a + .14)]], '#22262b', 'metal', { n: [-1, 0, 0], both: true })) } }
  // the glass: the canopy over the front, a streak of sky
  { const gl = H.glass, y0 = nx - .02 * b, y1 = nx - (gl === 'bubble' ? .42 : gl === 'pano' ? .52 : .3) * b, th0 = gl === 'bubble' ? -25 : gl === 'pano' ? -38 : 5;
    const ell = (y, th) => { const u = (y - rings[0][0]) / (rings[rings.length - 1][0] - rings[0][0]); let i = 0; while (i + 1 < rings.length - 1 && y < rings[i + 1][0]) i++;
      const A = rings[i], B = rings[i + 1], f = (y - A[0]) / ((B[0] - A[0]) || 1e-6), rx = lerp(A[1], B[1], f), rz = lerp(A[2], B[2], f); void u; return [rx * Math.cos(th) * 1.01, y, zc + rz * Math.sin(th) * 1.01] };
    for (const [d0, d1] of [[th0, 88], [92, 180 - th0]]) { const P = []; for (let i = 0; i <= 6; i++) P.push(ell(lerp(y0, y1, i / 6), d0 * D2R)); for (let i = 6; i >= 0; i--) P.push(ell(lerp(y0, y1, i / 6), d1 * D2R));
      decor.push(face(P, '#1d3346', 'glass', { n: [0, .4, .9], grad: ['#1a2c3d', '#7fa3c1'] })) }
    // the cabin's side windows (the coordinator 18:2x, D‑282: as the real one): the AW139's five large ones a side, the H130's two panoramic
    if (gl === 'wide' || gl === 'pano') { const nW = gl === 'wide' ? 5 : 2, ya = y1 - .03 * b, yb = gl === 'wide' ? -.3 * b : -.34 * b, st = (ya - yb) / nW, t0 = (gl === 'wide' ? 8 : 0) * D2R, t1 = (gl === 'wide' ? 42 : 64) * D2R;
      for (let i = 0; i < nW; i++) { const a0 = ya - i * st - st * .1, a1 = ya - (i + 1) * st + st * .1;
        for (const sd of [1, -1]) { const th = t => sd > 0 ? t : Math.PI - t, P = [ell(a0, th(t0)), ell(a1, th(t0)), ell(a1, th(t1)), ell(a0, th(t1))];
          decor.push(face(P, '#22384e', 'glass', { n: [sd, 0, .35], grad: ['#1a2c3d', '#6f93b1'] })) } } } }
  // the role markings: the EMS checker band, the corporate pin stripe, a light band along the top
  if (T.ems) for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { const y = .3 * b - i * .1 * b; for (const sd of [1, -1]) { const P = [[sd * hw * .97, y, zc - .1 * hz], [sd * hw * .97, y - .1 * b, zc - .1 * hz], [sd * hw * .97, y - .1 * b, zc + .2 * hz], [sd * hw * .97, y, zc + .2 * hz]]; if (i % 2) decor.push(face(P, T.acc, 'paint', { n: [sd, 0, 0] })) } }
  else decor.push({ line: 1, P: [[hw * .98, .35 * b, zc + .05 * hz], [hw * .98, -.42 * b, zc + .05 * hz]], c: T.acc, w: .12 }, { line: 1, P: [[-hw * .98, .35 * b, zc + .05 * hz], [-hw * .98, -.42 * b, zc + .05 * hz]], c: T.acc, w: .12 });
  if (T.fire) for (const sd of [1, -1]) decor.push(face([[sd * hw * .975, .38 * b, zc - .42 * hz], [sd * hw * .975, -.45 * b, zc - .42 * hz], [sd * hw * .975, -.45 * b, zc - .08 * hz], [sd * hw * .975, .38 * b, zc - .08 * hz]], T.acc, 'paint', { n: [sd, 0, 0] }));   // D‑149: the fire service's white band
  piece('body', body, { decor });
  // the gear: skids with their cross tubes, or wheels
  if (H.gear === 'skid') { const f = [], xs = bw * .68;
    for (const sd of [1, -1]) { f.push(...boxFaces([[sd * xs - .05, .5 * b], [sd * xs + .05, .5 * b], [sd * xs + .05, -.42 * b], [sd * xs - .05, -.42 * b]], 0, .1, { top: '#2a2e33', side: '#1b1e22' }, { mat: 'metal' }));
      for (const y of [.3 * b, -.2 * b]) f.push(...boxFaces([[sd * xs - .04, y - .04], [sd * hw * .5 + .04 * sd, y - .04], [sd * hw * .5 + .04 * sd, y + .04], [sd * xs - .04, y + .04]], .1, zs + .1, { top: '#3a3f45', side: '#2a2e33' }, { mat: 'metal' })) }
    piece('gear', f) }
  else { const r = .32; piece('gear', [], { tyres: [{ tyre: 1, x: -hw * .9, y: -.1 * b, r, w: .22 }, { tyre: 1, x: hw * .9, y: -.1 * b, r, w: .22 }, { tyre: 1, x: 0, y: .45 * b, r: r * .8, w: .18 }], legs: [{ x: 0, y: .45 * b, z0: r * .8, z1: zs, r: .08 }] }) }
  // the main rotor: the mast, the hub, the blades (parked) or the disc (turning) — a piece of its own, high up
  { const zt = T.H ? Math.max(zc + hz + .25, T.H - .12) : zc + hz + .45, R2 = T.D / 2, f = [];
    f.push(...vcyl(0, yH, .12, zc + hz * .8, zt, '#3a3f45', 'metal', 10), ...vcyl(0, yH, .32, zt - .05, zt + .12, '#2a2e33', 'metal', 14));
    if (opt.spin) { const P = []; for (let i = 0; i < 36; i++) { const a = i / 36 * TAU; P.push([R2 * Math.cos(a), yH + R2 * Math.sin(a), zt + .06]) } f.push(face(P, '#d2dceb', 'glass', { n: [0, 0, 1], a: .2, ns: 1 })) }
    else for (let i = 0; i < T.nb; i++) { const a = .6 + i * TAU / T.nb, c = Math.cos(a), sn = Math.sin(a), w = .16; f.push(face([[-sn * w, yH + c * w, zt + .06], [R2 * c - sn * w, yH + R2 * sn + c * w, zt + .02], [R2 * c + sn * w, yH + R2 * sn - c * w, zt + .02], [sn * w, yH - c * w, zt + .06]], '#2c3036', 'metal', { n: [0, 0, 1], both: true })) }
    piece('rotor', f) }
  // D‑149 · the fire bucket (a Bambi bucket: a red-orange drum, a dark rim, open at the top) on its line from the belly hook: in the air
  // 9 m under the hook; standing, on the ground beside the right door with the line laid to it
  if (T.fire) { const f = [], d = [], hook = [0, yH, zs + .15], air = !!opt.spin, bx = air ? 0 : hw + 2.6, by = air ? yH : yH - 1.2, bz = air ? -9 : 0, r0 = .95, r1 = .8, hB = 1.6;
    f.push(...vcyl(bx, by, r1, bz, bz + hB * .45, '#d9441c', 'paint', 16), ...vcyl(bx, by, r0, bz + hB * .45, bz + hB, '#e2531f', 'paint', 16), ...vcyl(bx, by, r0 + .05, bz + hB - .12, bz + hB + .02, '#22201e', 'metal', 16));
    { const P = []; for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) { const a = i / 16 * TAU; P.push([bx + r0 * Math.cos(a), by + r0 * Math.sin(a), bz + hB]) } f.push(face(P, '#3a1c12', 'matte', { n: [0, 0, 1] })) }
    const top = [bx, by, bz + hB + .9];
    for (const a of [0, 2.1, 4.2]) d.push({ line: 1, P: [[bx + r0 * Math.cos(a), by + r0 * Math.sin(a), bz + hB], top], c: 'rgba(30,30,30,.85)', w: .05 });   // the bucket's own rigging
    d.push({ line: 1, P: air ? [hook, top] : [hook, [hook[0], hook[1], .05], [bx * .5, (hook[1] + by) / 2 + .6, .05], [bx, by - 1.4, .05], top], c: 'rgba(25,25,25,.9)', w: .06 });
    piece('bucket', f, { decor: d }) }
  shiftY(pieces, -yH); for (const p of pieces) bounds(p);   // the hub at the origin: the pose (the pad's centre) under the rotor
  return { pieces, info: { id, heli: true, t: Object.assign({ he: T.he, H: T.H || zc + hz + .6, zb: zs, fw: bw }, T), L, R: hw, yN: nx - yH, HS: T.D / 2 } };
}
function shiftY(pieces, dy) { if (!dy) return; const mv = P => P.map(q => [q[0], q[1] + dy, q[2]]);
  for (const p of pieces) { for (const f of p.faces || []) f.P = mv(f.P); for (const d of p.decor || []) if (d.P) d.P = mv(d.P); for (const r of p.tyres || []) r.y += dy; for (const l of p.legs || []) l.y += dy }
}
function bounds(p) { let yM = -1e9, zm = 1e9, xa = 1e9, xb = -1e9;
  const acc = q => { yM = Math.max(yM, q[1]); zm = Math.min(zm, q[2]); xa = Math.min(xa, q[0]); xb = Math.max(xb, q[0]) };
  for (const f of p.faces || []) for (const q of f.P) acc(q);
  if (p.tyres) for (const r of p.tyres) { acc([r.x - r.w / 2, r.y + r.r, 0]); acc([r.x + r.w / 2, r.y - r.r, 0]) }
  p.yMax = yM; p.zMin = Math.max(0, zm); p.x0 = xa; p.x1 = xb; return p }
// ======================================================================================================================================
// drawing.  M = { X, Y, s } : local metres → world px of the field: (X + x·s, Y + y·s − K·z·s); seam = the stroke width (world px)
function P2(M, p) { return [M.X + p[0] * M.s, M.Y + (p[1] - K * p[2]) * M.s] }
// the owner 14:39 (1): no grid of seams on the skin — a face's outline pushed out by d px (a mitre at each corner) and filled once, so
// that neighbours overlap a little and no background shows between them; no stroke (it drew the grid, and cost a second raster)
function growS(S, d) {
  const n = S.length, E = []; let ar = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const p = S[i], q = S[(i + 1) % n]; ar += p[0] * q[1] - q[0] * p[1] }
  const sg = ar >= 0 ? 1 : -1;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const p = S[i], q = S[(i + 1) % n], ex = q[0] - p[0], ey = q[1] - p[1], l = Math.hypot(ex, ey); E.push(l > 1e-6 ? [sg * ey / l, -sg * ex / l] : null) }
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) if (!E[i]) { let j = i; do { j = (j + n - 1) % n } while (!E[j] && j !== i); E[i] = E[j] || [0, 0] }
  return S.map((v, i) => { const a = E[(i + n - 1) % n], b = E[i], k = Math.max(.3, 1 + a[0] * b[0] + a[1] * b[1]); return [v[0] + d * (a[0] + b[0]) / k, v[1] + d * (a[1] + b[1]) / k] });
}
function drawFaces(c, faces, M, seam, o) {
  o = o || {};
  for (const f of faces) {
    if (f.line || f.text != null || f.mark) continue;
    const n = f.n || (f.g ? nrm([(f.g[0][0] + f.g[1][0]) / 2, (f.g[0][1] + f.g[1][1]) / 2, (f.g[0][2] + f.g[1][2]) / 2]) : faceN(f.P));
    if (!f.both) { const vis = f.g ? dot(faceN(f.P), VW) : dot(n, VW); if (vis <= 1e-3) continue }
    const S = f.P.map(p => P2(M, p)), gw = !f.noSeam && f.a == null && o.grow !== 0, G = gw ? growS(S, o.grow || .5) : S;
    c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(G[0][0], G[0][1]); for (let i = 1; i < G.length; i++) c.lineTo(G[i][0], G[i][1]); c.closePath();
    let fill;
    if (o.solid) fill = o.solid;
    else if (f.grad) { const h = S.length / 2 | 0, mid = (i0, i1) => { let x = 0, y = 0; for (let i = i0; i < i1; i++) { x += S[i][0]; y += S[i][1] } return [x / (i1 - i0), y / (i1 - i0)] }, A0 = f.gax ? P2(M, f.gax[0]) : mid(0, h), B0 = f.gax ? P2(M, f.gax[1]) : mid(h, S.length);
      const gr = c.createLinearGradient(A0[0], A0[1], B0[0], B0[1]), b = lit(n, f.m), gn = f.grad.length; f.grad.forEach((q, i) => gr.addColorStop(gn === 3 ? [0, .55, 1][i] : i / (gn - 1), litC(q, b))); fill = gr }
    else if (f.g4 && S.length === 4) {
      // the skin (the owner 14:39 (1)): the light at the four corners, a plane fitted to it on the screen, one gradient along that plane's
      // slope — the light continues from face to face both ways (no steps along the body); the same one fill
      const B = f.g4.map(q => lit(q, f.m)); let xc = 0, yc = 0, bc = 0; for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { xc += S[i][0] / 4; yc += S[i][1] / 4; bc += B[i] / 4 }
      let xx = 0, xy = 0, yy = 0, xb = 0, yb = 0; for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const dx = S[i][0] - xc, dy = S[i][1] - yc, db = B[i] - bc; xx += dx * dx; xy += dx * dy; yy += dy * dy; xb += dx * db; yb += dy * db }
      const det = xx * yy - xy * xy; let be = 0, ga = 0; if (det > 1e-9) { be = (xb * yy - yb * xy) / det; ga = (yb * xx - xb * xy) / det }
      let s0 = 0, s1 = 0; for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const v = (S[i][0] - xc) * be + (S[i][1] - yc) * ga; if (v < s0) s0 = v; if (v > s1) s1 = v }
      const dd = be * be + ga * ga;
      if (s1 - s0 < .004 || dd < 1e-12) fill = litC(f.c, bc);
      else { const gr = c.createLinearGradient(xc + be * s0 / dd, yc + ga * s0 / dd, xc + be * s1 / dd, yc + ga * s1 / dd); gr.addColorStop(0, litC(f.c, bc + s0)); gr.addColorStop(.5, litC(f.c, bc + (s0 + s1) / 2)); gr.addColorStop(1, litC(f.c, bc + s1)); fill = gr }
    }
    else if (f.g && S.length === 4) {
      // the gradient across the strip: from the middle of edge 0–3 to the middle of edge 1–2, perpendicular to the strip
      const A = [(S[0][0] + S[3][0]) / 2, (S[0][1] + S[3][1]) / 2], B = [(S[1][0] + S[2][0]) / 2, (S[1][1] + S[2][1]) / 2];
      let dx = S[3][0] - S[0][0], dy = S[3][1] - S[0][1]; const dl = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
      let bx = B[0] - A[0], by = B[1] - A[1];
      if (dl > 1e-6) { dx /= dl; dy /= dl; const pr = bx * dx + by * dy; bx -= pr * dx; by -= pr * dy }
      if (Math.hypot(bx, by) < 1e-4) fill = litC(f.c, lit(n, f.m));
      else { const gr = c.createLinearGradient(A[0], A[1], A[0] + bx, A[1] + by); gr.addColorStop(0, litC(f.c, lit(f.g[0], f.m))); gr.addColorStop(1, litC(f.c, lit(f.g[1], f.m))); fill = gr }
    } else fill = litC(f.c, lit(n, f.m));
    c.globalAlpha = f.a != null ? f.a : 1;
    c.fillStyle = fill; c.fill(); if (seam && !f.noSeam && !gw) { c.strokeStyle = fill; c.lineWidth = seam; c.lineJoin = 'round'; c.stroke() }
    c.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
}
function drawDecor(c, list, M, o) {
  o = o || {}; const oD = Object.assign({}, o, { grow: 0 });   // the decor keeps its exact outline (windows, panels)
  for (const d of list) {
    if (o.solid) { if (d.line || d.text || d.mark) continue; drawFaces(c, [d], M, 0, oD); continue }
    if (d.line) { if (d.n && dot(d.n, VW) <= 1e-3) continue; const S = d.P.map(p => P2(M, p)); c.strokeStyle = d.c; c.lineWidth = Math.max(.5 / (o.zoom || 1), d.w * M.s); c.lineCap = 'round'; if (d.dash) c.setLineDash(d.dash.map(v => v * M.s)); c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(S[0][0], S[0][1]); for (let i = 1; i < S.length; i++) c.lineTo(S[i][0], S[i][1]); c.stroke(); c.setLineDash([]); continue }
    if (d.text != null) { if (!d.text) continue; const p = P2(M, d.at), sz = d.size * M.s; if (sz * (o.zoom || 1) < 2.2) continue; c.save(); c.translate(p[0], p[1]); if (!d.flat) c.rotate(Math.PI / 2);
      c.font = (d.light ? '600 ' : '800 ') + sz + 'px Arial,"Noto Sans Hebrew",sans-serif'; c.textAlign = 'center'; c.textBaseline = 'middle'; c.direction = 'rtl';
      const w = c.measureText(d.text).width, mw = d.maxW * M.s; if (w > mw) c.font = (d.light ? '600 ' : '800 ') + (sz * mw / w) + 'px Arial,"Noto Sans Hebrew",sans-serif';
      if (d.halo) { c.lineJoin = 'round'; c.strokeStyle = d.halo; c.lineWidth = sz * .22; c.strokeText(d.text, 0, 0) } c.fillStyle = d.col; c.fillText(d.text, 0, 0); c.restore(); continue }
    if (d.mark) { const p = P2(M, d.at), s = d.size * M.s; c.save(); c.translate(p[0], p[1]); c.fillStyle = d.col; c.strokeStyle = d.col; c.lineWidth = s * .16;
      if (d.mark === 'bird') { c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(0, s * .5); c.lineTo(-s * .4, -s * .4); c.lineTo(0, -s * .15); c.lineTo(s * .4, -s * .4); c.closePath(); c.fill() }
      else if (d.mark === 'arc') { c.beginPath(); c.arc(0, 0, s * .45, -.4 + Math.PI / 2, 3.5 + Math.PI / 2); c.stroke() }
      else if (d.mark === 'chev') { c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(0, s * .5); c.lineTo(-s * .45, 0); c.lineTo(-s * .45, -s * .2); c.lineTo(0, s * .3); c.lineTo(s * .45, -s * .2); c.lineTo(s * .45, 0); c.closePath(); c.fill() }
      else if (d.mark === 'stripes') { for (const k of [-1, 0, 1]) c.fillRect(-s * .45, k * s * .28 - s * .07, s * .9, s * .14) }
      else if (d.mark === 'sun') { c.beginPath(); c.arc(0, 0, s * .26, 0, TAU); c.fill(); c.beginPath(); for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { const a = i / 8 * TAU; c.moveTo(Math.cos(a) * s * .34, Math.sin(a) * s * .34); c.lineTo(Math.cos(a) * s * .5, Math.sin(a) * s * .5) } c.stroke() }
      else if (d.mark === 'star') { c.beginPath(); for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) { const a = -Math.PI / 2 + i * Math.PI / 5, r = i % 2 ? s * .2 : s * .5; c.lineTo(Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r) } c.closePath(); c.fill() }
      else if (d.mark === 'ring') { c.beginPath(); c.arc(0, 0, s * .38, 0, TAU); c.stroke() }
      else if (d.mark === 'leaf') { c.beginPath(); c.ellipse(0, 0, s * .2, s * .48, 0, 0, TAU); c.fill() }
      else { c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(0, s * .5); c.lineTo(s * .32, 0); c.lineTo(0, -s * .5); c.lineTo(-s * .32, 0); c.closePath(); c.fill() }
      c.restore(); continue }
    drawFaces(c, [d], M, 0, oD);
  }
}
function drawGear(c, p, M, o) {
  o = o || {};
  const T = p.tyres.slice().sort((a, b) => a.y - b.y);
  const tyre = r => { const x = M.X + r.x * M.s, yc = M.Y + (r.y - K * r.r) * M.s, hh = r.r * Math.sqrt(1 + K * K) * M.s, hw = r.w / 2 * M.s;
    c.beginPath(); c.roundRect(x - hw, yc - hh, hw * 2, hh * 2, Math.min(hw, hh) * .7);
    if (o.solid) { c.fillStyle = o.solid; c.fill(); return }
    const g = c.createLinearGradient(x - hw, 0, x + hw, 0); g.addColorStop(0, '#2c3136'); g.addColorStop(.45, '#1d2125'); g.addColorStop(1, '#121417'); c.fillStyle = g; c.fill();
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.07)'; c.fillRect(x - hw * .7, yc - hh * .9, hw * 1.4, hh * .35) };
  const leg = l => { const x = M.X + l.x * M.s, y0 = M.Y + (l.y - K * l.z0) * M.s, y1 = M.Y + (l.y - K * l.z1) * M.s, w = l.r * M.s;
    if (o.solid) { c.fillStyle = o.solid; c.fillRect(x - w, y1, w * 2, y0 - y1); return }
    const g = c.createLinearGradient(x - w, 0, x + w, 0); g.addColorStop(0, '#c9ced2'); g.addColorStop(.5, '#9aa1a8'); g.addColorStop(1, '#5d646b'); c.fillStyle = g; c.fillRect(x - w, y1, w * 2, y0 - y1) };
  if (!o.solid) for (const r of T) { const x = M.X + r.x * M.s, y = M.Y + r.y * M.s; c.fillStyle = 'rgba(8,12,16,.38)'; c.beginPath(); c.ellipse(x + r.w * .15 * M.s, y + r.r * .15 * M.s, (r.w * .75 + .1) * M.s, r.r * .55 * M.s, 0, 0, TAU); c.fill() }   // R‑14 (3): the contact shadow
  const legs = p.legs || [], back = T.filter(r => r.y < (legs[0] ? legs[0].y : 1e9) - .01), front = T.filter(r => !back.includes(r));
  back.forEach(tyre); legs.forEach(leg); front.forEach(tyre);
}
// a piece of an aircraft (or any piece with faces + decor + tyres)
function drawPiece(c, p, M, seam, o) {
  o = o || {};
  if (p.tyres) drawGear(c, p, M, o); if (!p.faces.length) return;
  drawFaces(c, p.faces, M, seam, o);
  if (p.decor && p.decor.length) drawDecor(c, p.decor.filter(d => !d.late), M, o);
  if (p.decor) drawDecor(c, p.decor.filter(d => d.late), M, o);
}
// the shadow of a piece on the ground (opaque; the page lays the shadow layer down with its alpha)
function shadowPiece(c, p, M) {
  c.beginPath();
  const U = SUN(), SHX = U.x, SHY = U.y, S = q => [M.X + (q[0] + q[2] * SHX) * M.s, M.Y + (q[1] + q[2] * SHY) * M.s];
  if (p.tyres && !p.faces.length) { for (const r of p.tyres) { const a = S([r.x - r.w / 2, r.y - r.r, r.r]), w = r.w * M.s, h = r.r * 2 * M.s; c.rect(a[0], a[1] - h * .2, w + r.r * SHX * M.s, h) } for (const l of p.legs || []) { const a = S([l.x, l.y, l.z0]), b = S([l.x, l.y, l.z1]); c.moveTo(a[0] - l.r * M.s, a[1]); c.lineTo(b[0] - l.r * M.s, b[1]); c.lineTo(b[0] + l.r * M.s, b[1]); c.lineTo(a[0] + l.r * M.s, a[1]); c.closePath() } c.fill(); return }
  for (const f of p.faces) { if (f.line || f.ns) continue; let Q = f.P.map(S), ar = 0; for (let i = 0; i < Q.length; i++) { const a = Q[i], b = Q[(i + 1) % Q.length]; ar += a[0] * b[1] - b[0] * a[1] } if (Math.abs(ar) < 1e-6) continue; if (ar < 0) Q = Q.reverse();
    c.moveTo(Q[0][0], Q[0][1]); for (let i = 1; i < Q.length; i++) c.lineTo(Q[i][0], Q[i][1]); c.closePath() }
  c.fill('nonzero');
}
// the screen bounding box of a piece (world px)
function bboxPiece(p, M) {
  let x0 = 1e9, y0 = 1e9, x1 = -1e9, y1 = -1e9; const acc = s => { x0 = Math.min(x0, s[0]); x1 = Math.max(x1, s[0]); y0 = Math.min(y0, s[1]); y1 = Math.max(y1, s[1]) };
  for (const f of p.faces) for (const q of f.P) acc(P2(M, q));
  if (p.tyres) for (const r of p.tyres) { acc(P2(M, [r.x - r.w / 2, r.y, r.r * 2.2])); acc(P2(M, [r.x + r.w / 2, r.y + r.r, 0])) }
  if (p.legs) for (const l of p.legs) acc(P2(M, [l.x, l.y, l.z1]));
  return [x0 - 1, y0 - 1, x1 + 1, y1 + 1];
}
// the sort key of a piece, world px: y of its south edge + its lowest point's height / K
const keyOf = (p, M) => M.Y + p.yMax * M.s + p.zMin / K * M.s;

// ======================================================================================================================================
// ground service vehicles of the sample (boxes, the same sun) — a belt loader, a catering truck, a baggage tug with carts, cones
function gseBelt(x, y, dir, zTip, col) {   // dir: +1 = the belt rises toward east, −1 toward west; x, y = the rear end (metres)
  const L = 7.4, W = 2.1, f = [], d = dir, X = u => x + d * u;
  const P = (u0, u1, v0, v1) => [[X(u0), y + v0], [X(u1), y + v0], [X(u1), y + v1], [X(u0), y + v1]];
  f.push(...boxFaces(P(0, L * .82, -W / 2, W / 2), .45, 1.15, { top: sh(col, -.05), side: sh(col, -.2) }, { mat: 'paint' }));
  f.push(...boxFaces(P(.2, 1.9, -W / 2 + .1, -.05), 1.15, 2.35, { top: '#2b3036', side: sh(col, -.1) }, { mat: 'paint' }));   // the driver's cab at the rear left
  const z0 = 1.25, z1 = zTip, u0 = .9, u1 = L + .4, bw = .62;

function a34ZFit(faces,S0,sh){const K=A34.K,VY=K/Math.hypot(K,1),VZ=1/Math.hypot(K,1),hx=sh?A34.SHX:0,hy=sh?A34.SHY:-K;let sw=0,Sx=0,Sy=0,Sz=0,Sxx=0,Sxy=0,Syy=0,Sxz=0,Syz=0;

// camera follow, the airport, the port trucks + gates and the trains (their timetable is a function of this clock). Each frame adds

// one fixed step of 1/60 s. The player, the camera, the mission timers, the airport and the train push-away run in every step; the
// traffic world (road vehicles, buses, people, D4 / C5 / A4 fleets, port trucks + gates) runs in every 3rd step with a step of exactly
// 0.05 s — the step the Road Core / Signal Core was verified with (QA-44); at 1/60 it gridlocks (GATE-75P S3 §0AE · K-32). Each world
// step covers the next 3 SIM steps (its state is the state at the end of that window), so the drawing always interpolates between two
// known world states. Same calls in the same order as the per-frame world update of v1.96 S4.

// interpolation — two groups: the traffic world (drawn between its last two world steps) and the player / camera / airport clock
// (drawn between the last two SIM steps)
const SIM_IP={mw:new Map(),mf:new Map(),fl:new Map(),genW:0,genF:0,saved:[],apt:null,pruneW:0,pruneF:0};
function simIpWorldEach(fn){for(const v of TRAFFIC_CARS)fn(v);for(const v of BUS_VEHICLES)fn(v);try{for(const v of D4_YARD_SEMIS)fn(v)}catch{}try{for(const m of a4FleetActors())fn(m)}catch{}for(const p of NPC_PEDESTRIANS)fn(p);for(const p of BUS_ALIGHTERS)fn(p);try{for(const p of F2_PEOPLE)fn(p);if(F2_PICKUP.walker)fn(F2_PICKUP.walker)}catch{}}
function simIpFastEach(fn){fn(PlayerCar);fn(PlayerPed);fn(Camera)}
function simIpRec(m,o,g){let r=m.get(o);if(!r){r={px:0,py:0,ph:0,cx:NaN,cy:NaN,ch:0,g:0};m.set(o,r)}r.px=o.x;r.py=o.y;r.ph=o.heading;r.g=g}
function simIpWorldSnapshot(){const m=SIM_IP.mw,g=++SIM_IP.genW;simIpWorldEach(o=>simIpRec(m,o,g));for(const v of FL_ACTIVE){let r=SIM_IP.fl.get(v.id);if(!r){r={px:0,py:0,ph:0,cx:NaN,cy:NaN,ch:0,g:0};SIM_IP.fl.set(v.id,r)}r.px=v.x;r.py=v.y;r.ph=v.heading;r.g=g}}
function simIpWorldPost(){const m=SIM_IP.mw,g=SIM_IP.genW;
 simIpWorldEach(o=>{const r=m.get(o);if(r&&r.g===g){r.cx=o.x;r.cy=o.y;r.ch=o.heading}});
 for(const v of FL_ACTIVE){const r=SIM_IP.fl.get(v.id);if(r&&r.g===g){r.cx=v.x;r.cy=v.y;r.ch=v.heading}else if(r)r.g=0}
 if(++SIM_IP.pruneW>=200){SIM_IP.pruneW=0;for(const [k,r] of m)if(r.g!==g)m.delete(k);for(const [k,r] of SIM_IP.fl)if(r.g!==g)SIM_IP.fl.delete(k)}}
function simInterpSnapshot(){const m=SIM_IP.mf,g=++SIM_IP.genF;simIpFastEach(o=>simIpRec(m,o,g));SIM_IP.apt=typeof APT_OPS!=='undefined'?{p:APT_OPS.clk,c:NaN}:null}
function simInterpPost(){const m=SIM_IP.mf,g=SIM_IP.genF;simIpFastEach(o=>{const r=m.get(o);if(r&&r.g===g){r.cx=o.x;r.cy=o.y;r.ch=o.heading}});if(SIM_IP.apt)SIM_IP.apt.c=APT_OPS.clk}
function simLerpA(a,b,t){if(!(Number.isFinite(a)&&Number.isFinite(b)))return b;let d=b-a;d=((d+Math.PI)%(2*Math.PI)+2*Math.PI)%(2*Math.PI)-Math.PI;return a+d*t}
function simInterpOne(o,r,t,gen){if(!r||r.g!==gen||o.x!==r.cx||o.y!==r.cy)return;const dx=r.cx-r.px,dy=r.cy-r.py;if(!(dx*dx+dy*dy<=14400))return;
 {const s=SIM_IP.saved,n=SIM_IP.sn|0;s[n]=o;s[n+1]=o.x;s[n+2]=o.y;s[n+3]=o.heading;SIM_IP.sn=n+4};o.x=r.px+dx*t;o.y=r.py+dy*t;if(typeof o.heading==='number'&&typeof r.ph==='number')o.heading=simLerpA(r.ph,r.ch,t)}
// tF: the moment between the last two SIM steps (player / camera / airport); tW: the moment inside the current world window
function simInterpApply(tF,tW){
 if(tW<1){const m=SIM_IP.mw,g=SIM_IP.genW;simIpWorldEach(o=>simInterpOne(o,m.get(o),tW,g));for(const v of FL_ACTIVE)simInterpOne(v,SIM_IP.fl.get(v.id),tW,g)}
 if(tF<1){const m=SIM_IP.mf,g=SIM_IP.genF;simIpFastEach(o=>simInterpOne(o,m.get(o),tF,g));const A=SIM_IP.apt;if(A&&Number.isFinite(A.p)&&APT_OPS.clk===A.c){SIM_IP.aptSaved=APT_OPS.clk;APT_OPS.clk=A.p+(A.c-A.p)*tF}}
 simTrackSample()}

function simInterpRestore(){const s=SIM_IP.saved,n=SIM_IP.sn|0;for(let i=0;i<n;i+=4){const o=s[i];o.x=s[i+1];o.y=s[i+2];if(s[i+3]!==undefined)o.heading=s[i+3];s[i]=null}SIM_IP.sn=0;if(SIM_IP.aptSaved!=null){APT_OPS.clk=SIM_IP.aptSaved;SIM_IP.aptSaved=null}}

  if(ts>warmup){fmax=Math.max(fmax,fr);fsum+=fr;cnt++;if(fr>=40&&first==null)first=ts}samples.push([ts,fr]);for(const v of TRAFFIC_CARS)fp=(Math.imul(fp,31)+Math.round(v.x*8)*3+Math.round(v.y*8))|0;for(const v of BUS_VEHICLES)fp=(Math.imul(fp,31)+Math.round(v.x*8))|0}}

// =====================================================================================================================================
// GATE-74T · ROAD CORE v2 + SIGNAL CORE v2
// One road contract for everything that drives on the public road graph: AI cars and service cars, taxis, C5 trucks, the four bus lines,
// the D4 semis. The E3 bus terminal, the airport bus bay, the D4 yard, the C5 yard/dock/port, taxi route planning, the A4 emergency
// paths, the port container trucks (FL, schedule-based), Airport Ground Ops, trains, boats and pedestrians keep their own code and talk
// to the core only through: lane occupancy ("ghosts"), hold lines, stop points and lane closures. Everything runs on one deterministic
// simulation clock (SIM), stepped by the frame loop; the core never reads wall time or Math.random.
//   • lane graph on the existing NODES/EDGES (one lane per direction on local/avenue, two on arterials; lane offsets = trafficEdgePoint)
//   • pass-through nodes (2 roads, no signal, no crosswalk) are road: connector curves, car-following continues, no ownership
//   • a junction owns a set of movements (approach lane → exit lane) with a geometric conflict matrix; a vehicle enters a junction only
//     when its movement is granted: signal allows, no conflicting occupant, FIFO among ready waiters, real receiving space on the exit
//     corridor (queue tail / next stop line / reservations of vehicles already granted into it), lane not closed, and — when the exit
//     corridor cannot hold the vehicle — the following junction(s) granted at the same time (linked junctions)
//   • stop lines are outside the box (crosswalk edge or crossing-road edge + margin); a vehicle never waits inside a junction
//   • uniform following along the path (same lane → curve → next lane), deterministic lane changes with a gap check
//   • Signal Core v2: same 14 phases, same drawing/pedestrian API, deterministic cycle with demand-based arrow/ped phases, clearance hold
//     by real occupancy (vehicles and pedestrians), and signal groups for junctions whose connecting storage is shorter than one vehicle
//   • failsafe only: a vehicle hard-blocked inside a box for CORE2.BACKOUT_AFTER seconds by another road vehicle backs out and re-queues
// GATE-75 S3 (D-05): the only engine — the previous one and its #core=1 switch were removed after the last validation run.
// =====================================================================================================================================
// GATE-75 S3 · QA-49 / TRAFFIC-03 (D-05): the declarations of the previous engine removed in S3 (88 functions and constants, 48028 chars).
// The audit reads the game source and proves that none of them is declared, called or assigned any more, that there is no engine
// switch, and that cars, buses, D4 semis and C5 trucks run on Road Core v2 with the signals on Signal Core v2.

function bezierPts2(p0,h0,p1,h1,n=14,kScale=.39,kMin=8){

var __GL2=null;
function ghostLaneGrid2(){const L=LANE_LIST2;if(__GL2&&__GL2.list===L&&__GL2.n===L.length)return __GL2;const C=256,pad=SCALE.lane/2+64+4,cells=new Map();

function ghostLanes2(body,heading){
 const out=[],pts=[[body.x??(body.ax+body.bx)/2,body.y??(body.ay+body.by)/2],[body.ax,body.ay],[body.bx,body.by]],r=body.radius||18,halfW=SCALE.lane/2;
 // GATE-75P: candidate lanes from the grid (bodies with r ≤ 64; a larger body falls back to the full list)
 let cand=null;if(r<=64){const G=ghostLaneGrid2(),g=++G.gen;cand=[];for(const [x,y] of pts){if(!Number.isFinite(x)||!Number.isFinite(y)){cand=null;break}const k=Math.floor(x/G.C)*100003+Math.floor(y/G.C),a=G.cells.get(k);if(a)for(const i of a)if(G.mark[i]!==g){G.mark[i]=g;cand.push(i)}}if(cand)cand.sort((p,q)=>p-q)}
 const n=cand?cand.length:LANE_LIST2.length;
 for(let ci=0;ci<n;ci++){const lane=cand?LANE_LIST2[cand[ci]]:LANE_LIST2[ci];
  const minx=Math.min(lane.ax,lane.bx)-halfW-r-4,maxx=Math.max(lane.ax,lane.bx)+halfW+r+4,miny=Math.min(lane.ay,lane.by)-halfW-r-4,maxy=Math.max(lane.ay,lane.by)+halfW+r+4;
  let sMin=Infinity,sMax=-Infinity,hit=false;
  for(const [x,y] of pts){if(x<minx||x>maxx||y<miny||y>maxy)continue;const dx=x-lane.ax,dy=y-lane.ay,sv=dx*lane.ux+dy*lane.uy;if(sv<-r||sv>lane.len+r)continue;const lat=Math.abs(-dx*lane.uy+dy*lane.ux);if(lat>halfW+r-2)continue;hit=true;sMin=Math.min(sMin,sv);sMax=Math.max(sMax,sv)}
  if(hit)out.push({lane,sMin:Math.max(0,sMin-r),sMax:Math.min(lane.len,sMax+r),aligned:trafficHeadingDiff(heading,lane.heading)<.65})
 }
 return out
}

function corridorEnd2(lane,depth=0,self=null){

// reservations needed beyond `mv` when its exit corridor cannot hold the vehicle: every following junction up to the first one with storage
function linkedChain2(v,mv,depth=0){

function tryGrant2(v,mv){

 if(held&&held.mv===mv){const chain=linkedChain2(v,mv);if(!chain){c.why='linked';return false}
  if(node.rb){const w=rbNear3(v,mv,node);if(w){c.why=w;return false}}   /* D‑600: at the line of a roundabout — the ring first */
  const o=node.inside.find(o=>o.v===v);if(o)o.remote=false;else node.inside.push({v,mv,remote:false,ghost:false});
  c.remotes=c.remotes.filter(r=>r.node!==node.id);for(const r of chain){node2Inside(r.node).push({v,mv:r.mv,remote:true,ghost:false});c.remotes.push(r)}
  c.granted=true;c.insideNode=node.id;c.why=null;c.ticket=null;return true}
 if(held)releaseRemotes2(v);

 // FIFO: an earlier waiter with a conflicting movement goes first when it is ready or merely waiting for the box to empty
 // (never towards a waiter that my own body in the box — standing past the line — is blocking: it cannot go before me)
 for(const w of node.waiting){if(w===v)continue;const wc=w.c2;if(!wc||wc.ticket==null||wc.ticket>c.ticket||!wc.gate||wc.gate.node!==node.id)continue;if(!wc.gate.mv.conflicts.has(mv.id))continue;if(node.inside.some(o=>o.v===v&&!o.remote&&o.mv&&o.mv.conflicts.has(wc.gate.mv.id)))continue;const wWhy=movementReady2(w,wc.gate.mv,node,{local:true});if(!wWhy||wWhy==='occupied'){if(wWhy==='occupied'&&fifoBehind2(v,w,wc.gate.mv,node)){CORE2_STATS.fifoBehind=(CORE2_STATS.fifoBehind||0)+1;continue}c.why='fifo';return false}}   /* p579b */

function pathLeader2(v){
 const c=v.c2,look=Math.max(CORE2.LOOK,v.speed*1.5+60);let best=null;
 const consider=(gap,o)=>{if(o.v===v||o.id===v.id)return;if(gap<look&&(!best||gap<best.gap))best={gap,id:o.id||(o.v&&o.v.id),kind:o.kind||'traffic',ref:o.v||o,ghost:!!o.ghost,speed:o.speed||0}};

  const rem=mv.len-c.ms;for(const o of mv.to.vs){if(o.v===v)continue;const d=rem+(o.s-mv.sEnd);if(d>-o.hl)consider(d-o.hl-c.hl-4,o)}

  if(mv.rb)rbLeader2(v,mv,consider);   /* p573 */
  return best}

 // a ghost's look-ahead point (kept free for the port truck / emergency vehicle) does not stop a vehicle that is already ahead of that ghost
 for(const o of lane.vs){if(o.v===v)continue;if(o.bodyS!=null&&c.s>=o.bodyS)continue;if(c.laneChanging&&c.lcPass&&o.id==='PLAYER-CAR')continue;   /* p236 */if(o.s>c.s||(o.s===c.s&&String(o.id)>String(v.id)))consider((o.s-o.hl)-(c.s+c.hl)-4,o)}

  for(const o of nx.vsCurve){if(o.v===v)continue;consider(dStart+o.ms-o.hl-c.hl-4-(nx.kind==='straight'||nx.cap>900?0:o.hl*.45+8),o)}

}

// occupancy is rebuilt once per tick; a vehicle that changes lane / curve during its step is registered at once, so that everyone stepping
// after it in the same tick sees it (receiving space, path leader, passable corridors)

function hardBlock2(v,x,y,heading,parked){
 const hit=dynamicVehicleBodyBlocked(v,x,y,heading,parked);if(!hit)return null;
 // two road vehicles touching each other: the one that is moving away (the other is behind it) may go on; the other keeps waiting
 const o=VEH_BY_ID2.get(hit);if(o&&o.c2&&o.c2.hardBy===v.id){const dx=o.x-v.x,dy=o.y-v.y,ahead=dx*Math.cos(heading)+dy*Math.sin(heading);if(ahead<-4)return null}
 // GATE-75 S3: a road vehicle that has closed up behind me (its body touches my rear, e.g. a bus cutting the chord of a corner) does not
 // hold me either — driving on only increases the distance; otherwise I wait for its contact while it waits for me as its lead
 if(o&&o!==v){const dx=o.x-v.x,dy=o.y-v.y,ahead=dx*Math.cos(heading)+dy*Math.sin(heading);if(ahead<-4&&(x-v.x)*dx+(y-v.y)*dy<=0&&Math.hypot(o.x-x,o.y-y)>Math.hypot(dx,dy)+.01)return null}
 // a vehicle driven by its own subsystem (emergency fleet, port truck) that has closed up behind me: driving away from it is always allowed
 if(!o){let g=null;try{g=a4FleetActors().find(q=>q.id===hit)||null}catch{}if(!g)try{g=FL_ACTIVE.find(q=>q.id===hit)||null}catch{}
  if(!g)try{g=D4_YARD_SEMIS.find(q=>q.id===hit&&q.k!=='road')||null}catch{}   /* linesA (10.11): גם סמי במסלול החצר של D4 שנסגר מאחוריי (יוצא אחריי לרחוב המחסנים) — בלי זה הסמי שעלה לכביש נעצר מהמגע, והבא נכנס לתוכו */
  if(g){const dx=g.x-v.x,dy=g.y-v.y,ahead=dx*Math.cos(heading)+dy*Math.sin(heading),moveAway=(x-v.x)*dx+(y-v.y)*dy<=0;if(ahead<-4&&moveAway)return null}}
 return hit
}
function stepVehicle2(v,dt,parked){
 const c=v.c2;
 if(c.cooldown>0)c.cooldown=Math.max(0,c.cooldown-dt);
 if(v.ghost>0)v.ghost=Math.max(0,v.ghost-dt);
 releaseCleared2(v);
 if(c.mv)return stepOnMovement2(v,dt,parked);
 if(c.laneBack>0)return laneBackStep2(v,dt,parked);
 const lane=c.lane,len=lane.len,node=NODES2.get(lane.nodeTo);
 // movement choice for the end of this lane and the gate (first real junction on the path) — once per lane / route position
 const key=lane.id+':'+(v.routeIndex??0);
 if(c.nextKey!==key){c.next=movementAt2(v,lane,true);c.nextKey=key;const g=gateFor2(v,lane,c.next);
  // a linked reservation made for exactly this gate (short corridor) is kept: it is converted into the grant at the line, ahead of FIFO
  if(!(g&&c.gate&&g.node===c.gate.node&&g.mv===c.gate.mv)){const keep=!!g&&!c.granted&&c.remotes.some(r=>r.node===g.node&&r.mv===g.mv);if(!keep&&(c.granted||c.remotes.length))releaseGrant2(v);c.ticket=null}
  c.gate=g}
 const nx=c.next,g=c.gate;
 // stop targets as distances from the vehicle centre
 let dStop=Infinity,stopKind=null;
 const sp=stopPoint2(v,lane);c.stopPoint=sp;if(sp){dStop=sp.s-c.s;stopKind=sp.kind}
 if(!nx){const d=Math.min(lane.stopS,len)-c.hl-2-c.s;if(d<dStop){dStop=d;stopKind='dead-end'}}
 const holdNose=holdLines2(v,lane);if(holdNose<Infinity&&holdNose-c.hl-c.s>=-2&&holdNose-c.hl-c.s<dStop){dStop=Math.max(0,holdNose-c.hl-c.s);stopKind='hold'}
 {const pg=pgHoldDist2(v,lane,nx);if(pg!=null&&pg>=-2&&pg<dStop){dStop=Math.max(0,pg);stopKind='hold'}}   // GATE-75 S4: port gate arm
 // keep-clear zones on this lane, or on the next lane behind a pass-through connector (then the hold point is the connector start)
 {const zs=[];if(lane.keepClear)for(const z of lane.keepClear)if(c.s+c.hl<=z.s0+.5)zs.push({z,zl:lane,d:z.s0-c.hl-c.s,via:null});
  if(nx&&nx.kind==='pass'&&nx.to.keepClear)for(const z of nx.to.keepClear){const dz=(nx.sStart-c.s)+nx.len+(z.s0-nx.sEnd)-c.hl;zs.push({z,zl:nx.to,d:z.s0<nx.sEnd+c.hl?Math.min(dz,nx.sStart-c.s-c.hl-4):dz,via:nx})}
  for(const q of zs){const z=q.z,d=q.d,brake=v.speed*v.speed/(2*TRAFFIC_DECEL);if(d<-1)continue;
   if(z.closed){if(d>=brake*.8-1&&d<dStop){dStop=Math.max(0,d);stopKind='hold'}continue}
   if(!q.via&&sp&&sp.s>=z.s0-c.hl&&sp.s<=z.s1+c.hl)continue;if(d>Math.max(CORE2.COMMIT_LOOK,brake+20))continue;
   if(!keepClearOk2(v,q.zl,z,q.via)){if(d<dStop){dStop=Math.max(0,d);stopKind='hold'}}}}
 let gated=false,dLine=Infinity;
 if(g&&!(sp&&g.lane===lane&&sp.s<=lane.stopS-c.hl)){dLine=gateLineDist2(v);const brake=v.speed*v.speed/(2*TRAFFIC_DECEL)+8;
  if(!c.granted&&!c.laneChanging&&dLine<=Math.max(CORE2.COMMIT_LOOK,brake+12)){tryGrant2(v,g.mv);if(!c.granted&&reroute2(v,dt,dLine))return stepVehicle2(v,0,parked)}
  if(!c.granted){gated=true;if(dLine<dStop){dStop=dLine;stopKind='line'}}}
 c.gateDist=dLine;
 // lane change intent (arterials): pre-position for the gate movement when the target lane is free beside me
 if(lane.cnt>1&&!c.granted&&!c.laneChanging&&!c.exitBoxNode&&!(v.curbStop&&v.curbStop.shift)&&(sp&&(sp.kind==='stop'||sp.kind==='d4-end'||sp.kind==='c5-final'&&v.logi)?true:(g&&(g.lane===lane||g.path&&g.path.length>1&&g.path[0].lane===lane&&g.lane.cnt===lane.cnt)))){const want=sp&&(sp.kind==='stop'||sp.kind==='d4-end'||sp.kind==='c5-final'&&v.logi)?lane.cnt-1:preferredK2(v,g.mv);   /* p477: גם לפני השער של D4. S7F193: וגם בקטע שלפני צומת המעבר, כשמספר הנתיבים זהה */if(want!=null&&want!==c.laneK&&(Math.min(lane.stopS,len)-c.s)>CORE2.LANE_CHANGE_MIN_AHEAD){const target=lane2(lane.edge,lane.dir,want);if(target&&laneChangeClear2(v,target)){c.laneChanging=true;c.laneFrom=lane;c.laneTo=target;c.laneBlend=0;c.laneBlendNext=0;target.vs.push({v,id:v.id,s:c.s,hl:c.hl,speed:v.speed||0,w:1})}}}
 g77PassPlayerCar(v,c,lane,dt);   /* GATE-77P · p211 · K-142 */
 // desired speed
 let desired=Math.min(v.targetSpeed,externalCap2(v));
 if(nx&&nx.cap<desired){const dCurve=Math.max(0,nx.sStart-c.s);desired=Math.min(desired,Math.sqrt(nx.cap*nx.cap+2*TRAFFIC_DECEL*dCurve))}
 if(dStop<Infinity)desired=Math.min(desired,Math.sqrt(2*TRAFFIC_DECEL*Math.max(0,dStop-1.5))+2);
 if(c.profile==='bus'&&sp&&sp.kind==='stop'){if(sp.s-c.s<BUS_CURB_APPROACH)desired=Math.min(desired,38)}
 if(c.profile==='bus'&&v.curbStop&&v.curbStop.edgeId===lane.edge&&v.curbStop.dirSign===lane.dir)desired=Math.min(desired,36);
 const lead=pathLeader2(v);
 let maxAdv=trafficDrive(v,dt,desired,lead);
 if(dStop<Infinity)maxAdv=Math.min(maxAdv,Math.max(0,dStop));
 let adv=Math.min(v.speed*dt,maxAdv);if(adv<v.speed*dt)v.speed=adv/Math.max(dt,1e-3);
 c.limit=limit2(v,adv,dStop,stopKind,lead,null);c.limitLead=lead?lead.id:null;c.limitGap=lead?lead.gap:null;holdNote2(c);if(ghostYield2(v,dt,lead,adv))return;
 const nextS=c.s+adv;
 // begin the movement when the curve start is reached (granted at the gate, or a pass-through connector)
 if(nx&&nextS>=nx.sStart&&(node.pt||c.granted)&&!c.laneChanging){const pose=polyPose2(nx.pts,Math.max(0,nextS-nx.sStart));const hard=adv>.001?hardBlock2(v,pose.x,pose.y,pose.heading,parked):null;if(hard)return blocked2(v,dt,hard,lead);
  beginMovement2(v,nx,nextS-nx.sStart);applyPose2(v,pose);c.blockT=0;c.stuckT=0;v.wait=false;v.stuck=0;return}
 let laneFrac=c.laneFrac;
 if(c.laneChanging){const blend=Math.min(1,c.laneBlend+adv/(c.lcPass&&c.lcLen?c.lcLen:CORE2.LANE_CHANGE_LEN))   /* p236 */;laneFrac=c.laneFrom.k+(c.laneTo.k-c.laneFrom.k)*blend;c.laneBlendNext=blend}
 const pose=lanePose2(lane,nextS,laneFrac);if(c.profile==='bus')busCurb2(v,lane,nextS,pose,sp);
 const hard=adv>.001?hardBlock2(v,pose.x,pose.y,pose.heading,parked):null;
 if(hard){if(c.laneChanging){c.lcBlockT=(c.lcBlockT||0)+dt;if(c.lcBlockT>1.5){const f=c.laneFrom;c.laneFrom=c.laneTo;c.laneTo=f;c.laneBlend=1-c.laneBlend;c.lcBlockT=0;c.lane=f;core2Event2('lane_change_reversed',{id:v.id,blocker:hard})}}return blocked2(v,dt,hard,lead)}
 c.lcBlockT=0;c.s=nextS;c.laneFrac=laneFrac;applyPose2(v,pose);
 if(c.laneChanging){c.laneBlend=c.laneBlendNext;if(c.laneBlend>=1){c.lane=c.laneTo;c.laneK=c.laneTo.k;c.laneFrac=c.laneK;c.laneChanging=false;c.laneFrom=null;c.laneTo=null;c.nextKey=null;c.next=null;c.gate=null;c.granted=false;c.lcPass=false;c.lcLen=null}}
 v.wait=v.speed<3&&(gated||dStop<Infinity||!!lead);
 if(adv>dt){c.blockT=0;c.stuckT=0;c.pedWait=0;c.stuckEvent=false;c.hardEvent=false;c.hardBy=null}
 else if(v.wait&&!gated&&!['hold','stop','term-wait','term-entry','airport4','d4-end','c5-final','taxi-final'].includes(stopKind)){c.stuckT+=dt;if(c.stuckT>CORE2.STUCK_EVENT*2&&!c.stuckEvent){c.stuckEvent=true;v.queueWatchdogs=(v.queueWatchdogs||0)+1;core2Event2('queue_watchdog',{id:v.id,lane:lane.id,lead:lead?.id||null})}}
 v.stuck=c.stuckT+c.blockT;
 // arrival at a stop point
 if(sp&&c.s>=sp.s-.05)arrive2(v,sp);
}
function stepOnMovement2(v,dt,parked){
 const c=v.c2,mv=c.mv;
 if(c.backout)return backoutStep2(v,dt,parked);
 let desired=Math.min(v.targetSpeed,mv.cap,externalCap2(v));
 // on a pass-through connector the gate may lie ahead: keep braking for its stop line and ask for the grant on the way
 let dLine=Infinity;const g=c.gate;
 if(mv.kind==='pass'&&g&&!c.granted){dLine=gateLineDist2(v);const brake=v.speed*v.speed/(2*TRAFFIC_DECEL)+8;if(!c.granted&&dLine<=Math.max(CORE2.COMMIT_LOOK,brake+12))tryGrant2(v,g.mv);if(!c.granted)desired=Math.min(desired,Math.sqrt(2*TRAFFIC_DECEL*Math.max(0,dLine-1.5))+2);else dLine=Infinity}
 c.gateDist=dLine;
 const lead=pathLeader2(v);
 let maxAdv=trafficDrive(v,dt,desired,lead);
 if(dLine<Infinity)maxAdv=Math.min(maxAdv,Math.max(0,dLine));
 let adv=Math.min(v.speed*dt,maxAdv);if(adv<v.speed*dt)v.speed=adv/Math.max(dt,1e-3);
 c.limit=limit2(v,adv,Infinity,null,lead,dLine<Infinity?dLine:null);c.limitLead=lead?lead.id:null;c.limitGap=lead?lead.gap:null;holdNote2(c);if(ghostYield2(v,dt,lead,adv))return;
 const ms=c.ms+adv;
 if(ms>=mv.len){const over=ms-mv.len,pose=lanePose2(mv.to,mv.sEnd+over,mv.to.k);const hard=adv>.001?hardBlock2(v,pose.x,pose.y,pose.heading,parked):null;if(hard)return blocked2(v,dt,hard,lead);
  c.ms=ms;endMovement2(v);applyPose2(v,pose);c.blockT=0;c.stuckT=0;v.wait=false;v.stuck=0;return}
 const pose=polyPose2(mv.pts,ms);const hard=adv>.001?hardBlock2(v,pose.x,pose.y,pose.heading,parked):null;
 if(hard)return blocked2(v,dt,hard,lead);
 c.ms=ms;applyPose2(v,pose);v.wait=v.speed<3&&(!!lead||dLine<Infinity);if(adv>dt){c.blockT=0;c.stuckT=0;c.hardEvent=false;c.hardBy=null}else if(mv.kind!=='pass'&&c.ms>2){c.stuckT+=dt;if(c.stuckT>=CORE2.BACKOUT_AFTER&&!c.backout&&!mv.rb){c.backout=true;c.forwardClear=0;v.recoveries2=(v.recoveries2||0)+1;v.backouts=(v.backouts||0)+1;const info={id:v.id,junction:mv.node,blocker:lead?lead.id:null,ms:+c.ms.toFixed(1),stuckFor:+c.stuckT.toFixed(1)};core2Event2('junction_backout',info);try{SaveManager.log('traffic','junction_backout',info)}catch{}}}v.stuck=c.blockT+c.stuckT;
}
// moving from pose (v.x,v.y) to p increases the distance to the vehicle `hitId` it already touches and does not head towards it
function movingAwayFrom2(v,p,hitId){try{const o=[...TRAFFIC_CARS,...BUS_VEHICLES,...(typeof D4_YARD_SEMIS==='undefined'?[]:D4_YARD_SEMIS),...(typeof a4FleetActors==='function'?a4FleetActors():[])].find(q=>q.id===hitId);if(!o||o===v)return false;
 const dx=o.x-v.x,dy=o.y-v.y,mx=p.x-v.x,my=p.y-v.y;if(mx*dx+my*dy>0)return false;if(Math.hypot(o.x-p.x,o.y-p.y)<=Math.hypot(dx,dy))return false;
 return dynamicVehicleBodyBlocked(v,v.x,v.y,v.heading,parkedStepList())===hitId}catch{return false}}
// a yard / station vehicle (C5 yard truck, emergency fleet) whose own path crosses my lane is stopped by my body, while I wait for its
// ghost in front of me: I am the one that can reverse, so I back off a little and let it cross
/* linesA (10.11): נסיגה מהגוף שכבר נוגעים בו מותרת כשהמרווח בין שני הגופים גדל (לא לפי המרכזים: מול גוף ארוך המרכז מתרחק והזנב מתקרב) */
function backingAway2(v,p,hitId){try{const o=[...TRAFFIC_CARS,...BUS_VEHICLES,...(typeof D4_YARD_SEMIS==='undefined'?[]:D4_YARD_SEMIS),...(typeof a4FleetActors==='function'?a4FleetActors():[])].find(q=>q.id===hitId);if(!o||o===v)return false;
 const ob=trafficVehicleShape(o),g=s=>{for(const m of [0,.6,1.2,1.8,2.4,3.2,4.5,6,8,11])if(vehicleBodiesOverlap(s,ob,m))return m;return 99};
 const g0=g(vehicleCollisionShape(v.asset,v.ref||'Sedan',v.x,v.y,v.heading)),g1=g(vehicleCollisionShape(v.asset,v.ref||'Sedan',p.x,p.y,p.heading));if(g0>=8)return false;   /* לא נוגעים עכשיו — זו לא נסיגה ממגע */
 return g1>g0||(g1===g0&&g1>0&&Math.hypot(o.x-p.x,o.y-p.y)>Math.hypot(o.x-v.x,o.y-v.y))}catch{return false}}
function subsystemBlockedBy2(id,v){const gid=String(id).replace(/\+$/,'');
 try{const t=TRAFFIC_CARS.find(q=>q.id===gid&&q.c5&&q.c5.mode!=='road');if(t)return t.c5.blockedBy===v.id}catch{}
 try{const m=typeof a4FleetActors==='function'?a4FleetActors().find(q=>q.id===gid):null;if(m){if((m.blocked||0)>0&&m.blockBy!=null)return String(m.blockBy)===String(v.id);   /* linesA (10.11): המכלית, המשאית והטנדר של D5 / C5 רושמים מי חוסם אותם (blockBy) בתנוחה שלהם עצמם (המכלית — על שני סרנים, 6 פיקס׳ בתוך הקשת); הבדיקה לפי הנקודה שבמסלול החזירה "לא חסום", והמכונית שעמדה על הדרך של המכלית לא נסוגה אף פעם */const np=a4FleetPose(m.route,Math.min(m.route.total,m.d+2));return a4FleetBlocked(m,np)===v.id}}catch{}
 return false}
function ghostYield2(v,dt,lead,adv){const c=v.c2;
 if(!(lead&&lead.ghost&&adv<=dt&&dt>0&&!c.laneBack&&!c.backout&&subsystemBlockedBy2(lead.id,v))){c.ghostYieldT=0;return false}
 c.ghostYieldT=(c.ghostYieldT||0)+dt;if(c.ghostYieldT<CORE2.GHOST_YIELD_AFTER)return false;c.ghostYieldT=0;
 if(c.mv){if(NODES2.get(c.mv.node).pt||c.ms<=2)return false;c.backout=true;c.forwardClear=0}else c.laneBack=CORE2.GHOST_YIELD_BACK;
 v.recoveries2=(v.recoveries2||0)+1;v.backouts=(v.backouts||0)+1;core2Event2('ghost_yield',{id:v.id,to:lead.id,lane:c.lane?c.lane.id:null,mv:c.mv?c.mv.id:null});return true}
function a4BlockedBy2(id,v){try{if(typeof a4FleetActors!=='function')return false;const m=a4FleetActors().find(q=>q.id===id);if(!m||!((m.blocked||0)>1))return false;const ahead=(m.x-v.x)*Math.cos(v.heading)+(m.y-v.y)*Math.sin(v.heading);return ahead>0}catch{return false}}
// a ghost (port truck / emergency vehicle / yard vehicle) touching the box from behind me on my own approach does not occupy my way out
function ghostBehind2(v,o){if(o.x==null)return false;const h=v.heading,dx=o.x-v.x,dy=o.y-v.y,along=dx*Math.cos(h)+dy*Math.sin(h),lat=Math.abs(-dx*Math.sin(h)+dy*Math.cos(h));return along<-(v.c2.hl+4)&&lat<18&&trafficHeadingDiff(o.heading,h)<.6}
function blocked2(v,dt,hardId,lead){
 const c=v.c2;v.speed=0;v.wait=true;c.blockT+=dt;v.stuck=c.stuckT+c.blockT;c.hardBy=hardId;c.limit='contact:'+hardId;c.limitLead=hardId;
 // p441: a long vehicle turning in the box held by the body of a vehicle on a lane of the same junction (granted and creeping to its curve,
 // or at its line) or of a lane it touches both ways: that one can reverse — it backs off 4 m at once (was: the one in the box backed out after 12 s)
 if(c.mv&&!NODES2.get(c.mv.node).pt&&c.blockT>=FLEET_SWEEP2.yieldAfter){const o=VEH_BY_ID2.get(hardId),oc=o&&o.c2;if(oc&&!oc.mv&&!oc.laneBack&&!oc.backout&&oc.lane&&oc.lane!==c.mv.from&&(oc.lane.nodeTo===c.mv.node||oc.hardBy===v.id)){
  oc.laneBack=FLEET_SWEEP2.yieldBack;o.recoveries2=(o.recoveries2||0)+1;FLEET_SWEEP2.yields++;c.blockT=0;core2Event2('long_turn_yield',{id:o.id,to:v.id,node:c.mv.node})}}
 // p441: a granted vehicle creeping to its curve with its nose past its line (a 13.5 m bus reaches 6.7 m ahead of its centre — into the
 // exit lane of the crossing road) and a vehicle there touch each other, both on lanes: the creeping one backs off 4 m after 1.5 s (was 12 s)
 if(!c.mv&&c.granted&&c.lane&&!c.laneBack&&c.blockT>=1.5*FLEET_SWEEP2.yieldAfter&&c.s+c.hl>c.lane.stopS+4){const o=VEH_BY_ID2.get(hardId),oc=o&&o.c2;if(oc&&!oc.mv&&oc.hardBy===v.id){
  c.laneBack=FLEET_SWEEP2.yieldBack;v.recoveries2=(v.recoveries2||0)+1;FLEET_SWEEP2.yields++;core2Event2('creep_yield',{id:v.id,to:o.id,lane:c.lane.id});return}}
 // p441: turning in the box, held by the body of a vehicle that stands on the next link waiting for its own gate (a signal) — it will not move
 // soon and cannot reverse: the one in the box backs out along its curve after 3.5 s (was 12 s) and tries again
 if(c.mv&&!NODES2.get(c.mv.node).pt&&!c.backout&&c.ms>2&&c.blockT>=FLEET_SWEEP2.gateBackAfter){const o=VEH_BY_ID2.get(hardId),oc=o&&o.c2;if(oc&&oc.mv&&oc.mv.node!==c.mv.node&&!oc.hardBy&&!oc.backout){

 const ped=NPC_PEDESTRIANS.find(q=>q.id===hardId);
 if(ped){c.pedWait+=dt;if(c.pedWait>CORE2.PED_WAIT){ped.ghost=3.2;ped.blockT=0;c.pedWait=0;v.pedReleases=(v.pedReleases||0)+1;v.deadlockRelease=(v.deadlockRelease||0)+1;core2Event2('ped_release',{id:v.id,ped:hardId})}return}
 if(c.blockT>=CORE2.STUCK_EVENT&&!c.hardEvent){c.hardEvent=true;v.hardEpisodes=(v.hardEpisodes||0)+1;core2Event2('hard_block',{id:v.id,blocker:hardId,inBox:!!c.mv,lane:c.lane?c.lane.id:null})}
 // an emergency vehicle on its station path cannot reverse: a road vehicle whose body blocks it (while it blocks the road vehicle) yields
 const a4Stuck=a4BlockedBy2(hardId,v);

function backoutStep2(v,dt,parked){
 const c=v.c2,mv=c.mv;c.limit='recovery';
 // the way forward opened? finish the turn instead of reversing
 {let clear=true;for(let d=1;d<=36;d+=2.5){const p=polyPose2(mv.pts,Math.min(mv.len,c.ms+d));if(hardBlock2(v,p.x,p.y,p.heading,parked)){clear=false;break}}if(clear){c.forwardClear=(c.forwardClear||0)+dt;if(c.forwardClear>=1.2){c.backout=false;c.blockT=0;c.forwardClear=0;c.hardEvent=false;core2Event2('junction_backout_resumed',{id:v.id,junction:mv.node});return}}else c.forwardClear=0}
 const ms=Math.max(0,c.ms-CORE2.BACKOUT_SPEED*dt),pose=polyPose2(mv.pts,ms);v.speed=0;v.wait=true;
 {const hb=hardBlock2(v,pose.x,pose.y,pose.heading,parked);if(hb&&!backingAway2(v,pose,hb))return}   /* linesA (10.11): נסיגה שמתרחקת מהגוף שכבר נוגעים בו — מותרת (hardBlock2 מתיר להתרחק רק ממי שמאחור; בנסיגה החוסם מלפנים) */
 c.ms=ms;applyPose2(v,pose);
 if(ms<=0){const from=mv.from,s=Math.min(mv.sStart,from.stopS-c.hl);const p=lanePose2(from,s,from.k);if(s<mv.sStart&&hardBlock2(v,p.x,p.y,p.heading,parked))return;
  c.lane=from;c.s=s;c.laneK=c.laneFrac=from.k;c.mv=null;c.ms=0;c.backout=false;c.blockT=0;c.hardEvent=false;c.cooldown=CORE2.BACKOUT_COOLDOWN+(stableHash(String(v.id))%5)*.3;releaseGrant2(v);c.next=null;c.nextKey=null;applyPose2(v,p);core2Event2('junction_backout_done',{id:v.id,junction:mv.node})}
}
function laneBackStep2(v,dt,parked){
 const c=v.c2;c.limit='recovery';const lane=c.lane,step=Math.min(c.laneBack,CORE2.BACKOUT_SPEED*dt),s2=Math.max(0,c.s-step),p=lanePose2(lane,s2,c.laneFrac);v.speed=0;v.wait=true;
 const done=()=>{c.laneBack=0;c.blockT=0;c.hardEvent=false;c.hardBy=null;c.cooldown=CORE2.BACKOUT_COOLDOWN;if(c.granted||c.remotes.length)releaseGrant2(v);c.nextKey=null;c.next=null;c.gate=null};
 {const hb=s2>0?hardBlock2(v,p.x,p.y,p.heading,parked):null;if(s2<=0||(hb&&!backingAway2(v,p,hb))){done();return}}   /* linesA (10.11): כנ"ל — מכונית שנעצרה במגע עם המכלית (שחוצה את הנתיב שלה ב-J31_42) ניסתה לסגת 138 פעמים, וכל ניסיון בוטל מיד */
 c.s=s2;applyPose2(v,p);c.laneBack-=step;if(c.laneBack<=0)done()
}
// the kerb pull-in is only drawn from the kerb lane: a bus that could not change into it stops in its own lane (pulling sideways from an
// inner lane would push its body into the vehicle beside it)
function curbShift2(v,lane,stop){return(lane.cnt<2||lane.k===lane.cnt-1)?busStopCurbShift(v,stop):0}
function busCurb2(v,lane,nextS,pose,sp){
 // kerb pull-in before a street stop and merge back after departure (same shape as busCurbVector)
 const stop=sp&&sp.kind==='stop'?sp.stop:null,stopRemain=stop?sp.s-nextS:Infinity;let st=null,f=0,shift=0;
 if(stop&&stopRemain<=BUS_CURB_APPROACH){st=stop;shift=curbShift2(v,lane,st);f=busSmooth01(1-stopRemain/BUS_CURB_APPROACH)}
 else if(v.curbStop&&v.curbStop.edgeId===lane.edge&&v.curbStop.dirSign===lane.dir){st=v.curbStop;const dist=Math.max(0,nextS-st.t*lane.len);shift=Number.isFinite(st.shift)?st.shift:busStopCurbShift(v,st);if(dist<=BUS_CURB_EXIT)f=1-busSmooth01(dist/BUS_CURB_EXIT);else v.curbStop=null}
 else if(v.curbStop)v.curbStop=null;
 if(st&&f>0){pose.x+=st.nx*shift*f;pose.y+=st.ny*shift*f}
}
function arrive2(v,sp){
 const c=v.c2,lane=c.lane;
 if(sp.kind==='stop'){const stop=sp.stop,stops=busStopsForLine(v.line);c.s=sp.s;const shift=curbShift2(v,lane,stop);v.curbStop={...stop,t:stop.t,shift};const p=lanePose2(lane,c.s,c.laneFrac);p.x+=stop.nx*shift;p.y+=stop.ny*shift;applyPose2(v,p);v.speed=0;const ex=exchangeBusPassengers(v,stop);spawnBusAlighters(v,stop,ex.alight);v.dwell=Math.max(Math.min(5.2,2.1+ex.board*.19+ex.alight*.12),p560Need(v));   /* p560: until the doors close */v.wait=true;v.stopCursor=(v.stopCursor+1)%stops.length;v.stuck=0;c.stuckT=0;SaveManager.log('transit',`line${v.line}_stop`,{line:v.line,bus:v.id,stop:stop.id,dwell:+v.dwell.toFixed(2),passengers:v.passengers});return}
 if(sp.kind==='term-entry'){writeCompat2(v);const bay=termAdmit(v);if(bay){releaseGrant2(v);beginBusTerminal(v,bay);v.c2=null;return}termEntryWait(v,SIM.dt);v.speed=0;v.wait=true;return}
 if(sp.kind==='term-wait'){termEntryWait(v,SIM.dt);v.speed=0;v.wait=true;return}
 if(sp.kind==='airport4'){v.speed=0;v.wait=true;return}   // airport4Tick takes the bus from here (it reads bus.t)
 if(sp.kind==='c5-final'){writeCompat2(v);releaseGrant2(v);c5RoadArrived(v);v.c2=null;return}
 if(sp.kind==='d4-end'){v.d4RouteDone=true;v.speed=0;v.wait=true;return}
 if(sp.kind==='taxi-final'){writeCompat2(v);releaseGrant2(v);taxiServiceArrived(v);return}
}

function placeFix2(vehicles,parked){

  let done=false;for(let s2=maxS;s2>=hl+4;s2-=12){const p=lanePose2(lane,s2,k);if(!dynamicVehicleBodyBlocked(v,p.x,p.y,p.heading,parked)){v.t=s2/lane.len;v.x=p.x;v.y=p.y;v.heading=p.heading;v.speed=0;v.c2=null;CORE2_STATS.placeFixed=(CORE2_STATS.placeFixed||0)+1;done=true;break}}

}
// isolated-motion watchdog: a vehicle that nothing legal holds (no lead, no red, no hold, no stop, no contact) must move; if it does not, that
// is an engine stall, not a traffic jam
function holdNote2(c){if(c.limit!=='moving'&&c.limit!=='free'){c.holdLimit=c.limit;c.holdLead=c.limitLead;c.holdGap=c.limitGap}}
function motionWatch2(v,dt,x0,y0){const c=v.c2;
 // isolated-motion watchdog: the core says nothing holds this vehicle ('free' / 'moving') — it must make net progress
 if(c.limit==='free'||c.limit==='moving'){if(!c.freeAnchor){c.freeAnchor=[x0,y0];c.freeStopT=0}c.freeStopT+=dt;const d=Math.hypot(v.x-c.freeAnchor[0],v.y-c.freeAnchor[1]);if(d>=1){c.freeAnchor=[v.x,v.y];c.freeStopT=0;c.stallEvent=false}}
 else{c.freeAnchor=null;c.freeStopT=0;c.stallEvent=false}

// explanation of a stopped vehicle for QA: gridlock (a legal blocker holds it) vs contact (bodies touching) vs subsystem vs unexplained
function core2Explain(v){const c=v.c2;if(!c){if(v.term||v.airport4)return{cls:'subsystem',limit:'bus-terminal'};if(v.c5&&v.c5.mode!=='road')return{cls:'subsystem',limit:'c5-yard'};if(isD4Semi2(v)&&v.k!=='road')return{cls:'subsystem',limit:'d4-yard'};return{cls:'unexplained',limit:'no-core-state'}}

 // released this very tick after a hold: explained by that hold

 let cls;if(L==='free'||L==='moving')cls='unexplained';else if(L.startsWith('contact:'))cls='contact';else if(L.startsWith('subsystem')||L==='term-wait'||L==='term-entry'||L==='airport4'||L.startsWith('stop:')||L==='bus-headway'||L==='a4-priority')cls='subsystem';else cls='gridlock';

function busFreezeWatch2(dt){
 for(const bus of BUS_VEHICLES){const c=bus.c2;if(!c||bus.term||bus.airport4||bus.dwell>0){bus.freezeT=0;continue}
  const x0=Number.isFinite(bus.freezeLastX)?bus.freezeLastX:bus.x,y0=Number.isFinite(bus.freezeLastY)?bus.freezeLastY:bus.y,moved=Math.hypot(bus.x-x0,bus.y-y0)>1.1||bus.speed>2.2;bus.freezeLastX=bus.x;bus.freezeLastY=bus.y;
  if(moved||bus.wait){bus.freezeT=0;continue}
  bus.freezeT=(bus.freezeT||0)+dt;if(bus.freezeT>=BUS_FREEZE_RECOVER_SECONDS){bus.freezeT=0;bus.freezeRecoveries=(bus.freezeRecoveries||0)+1;SaveManager.log('transit','bus_freeze_watchdog',{bus:bus.id,line:bus.line,lane:c.lane?c.lane.id:null,why:c.why||null})}}
}

// GATE-74T · TRAFFIC-01 acceptance harness. Runs the whole city fleet (cars, buses, D4 semis, C5 trucks, A4 emergency fleet, pedestrians,
// port trucks, signals) headless for `seconds` and reports the owner's acceptance criteria:
//   no citywide freeze · 0 body overlaps · frozen vehicles ≤ 2 on average after the warm-up and not growing · emergency recoveries ≤ 5/min
//   over the last 20 min · every bus line, the D4 semis, the C5 trucks and the A4 emergency fleet keep completing cycles (also in the last
//   20 min) · Road Core, Signal Core, Bus, D4, C5 and A4 advance on one simulation clock (no drift).
// frozen = no movement for 60 s without a legitimate reason (bus stop / terminal / airport-bay dwell, taxi hold).
// Diagnostics (diag): every frozen vehicle is classified by what holds it — gridlock (a legal blocker: lead / red signal / occupied box /
// receiving space / queue order / reservation / hold line), contact (bodies touching), subsystem (terminal, yard, gate) or UNEXPLAINED
// (nothing holds it: an engine stall, not a jam). It also counts every tick of every subsystem, signal phase advances, the size of every
// lock / reservation / queue / cache map over time, throughput, and snapshots the first freeze.
// seed re-places the AI cars deterministically; parkPlayer moves the player's car off the road for the run (restored afterwards).

/* 1 · the arc of a movement: from the entry point round to the exit point, the way the ring turns (θ decreasing). An entry and an exit next to
   each other (a right turn from / into an outer lane) leave less than the two lead angles between them: the leads shrink and the arc is short. */
function rbArc3(R,pin,pout,same){const TAU=Math.PI*2;let dA=R.dA;
 if(RB3.on&&!same){const span=rbMod2(pin-pout);if(span<2*dA+.12){dA=Math.max(.06,(span-.12)/2);RB3.loopFix++}}
 const a0=pin-dA;let D=(a0-(pout+dA))%TAU;if(D<0)D+=TAU;
 if(!RB3.on||same){if(D<.12)D+=TAU}else if(D>TAU-.6)D=.06;
 return{a0,D,dA}}
/* a hotel / emergency vehicle on its own path that is held (a hold, a gate, a contact) stands, whatever its cruise speed field says */
function rbActorSpeed3(v){if(v&&v.route&&v.d!=null&&((v.holdT||0)>0||(v.blocked||0)>0||(v.waitFleet||0)>0||(v.stopLeft||0)>0))return 0;return Math.abs(v.speed||0)}
/* 2 · the walker at a crossing of a roundabout steps down when no body is on the crossing and every vehicle coming to it can still stop */
function rbZebraGap3(z){const e=byEdge[z.roadId];if(!e)return true;const hw=(TYPES[e.cls]||TYPES.local).width/2,hor=z.stripeAxis==='horizontal',hd=17;
 for(const v of signalTrafficActors()){if(!v||v.hidden)continue;try{if(VehicleWorld.hidden&&VehicleWorld.hidden.has(v.id))continue}catch(e2){}
  const al=hor?v.x-z.x:v.y-z.y,lat=hor?v.y-z.y:v.x-z.x;if(Math.abs(lat)>hw+12)continue;
  const hl=trafficVehicleHalfLength(v),sp=rbActorSpeed3(v),c=v.c2,A=Math.abs(al);
  if(A<hl+(sp<1?3:18)){RB3.n.onZebra++;return false}                       // a body on the crossing
  if(sp<1)continue;                                                         // standing clear of it
  const ring=!!(c&&c.mv&&c.mv.rb&&c.mv.node===z.node);
  if(ring&&c.mv.to.edge!==z.arm&&c.mv.to.edge!==z.roadId)continue;          // on the ring, not leaving by this arm
  let dist=A-hl-hd;
  if(ring){const to=c.mv.to,zs=(z.x-to.ax)*to.ux+(z.y-to.ay)*to.uy;dist=(c.mv.len-c.ms)+(zs-c.mv.sEnd)-hl-hd}
  else{const h=v.heading||0;if(al*(hor?Math.cos(h):Math.sin(h))>0)continue}  // driving away from it
  if(!c){if(sp>8&&A<60+hl+sp*.9){RB3.n.fleet++;return false}continue}      // not a vehicle of the road core (its own path, the player): the old margin
  if(dist<sp*sp/(2*TRAFFIC_DECEL)+sp*.5+30){RB3.n.close++;return false}}   // too close to stop before the crossing: it passes first
 RB3.n.walk++;return true}

function rbZebraAhead3(v,mv){const to=mv.to,Z=to.rbz;if(!Z||!RB3.on)return false;

/* 4 · at the line with a linked reservation: give way to whoever is on the ring in front of the entry (or just past it) */
function rbNear3(v,mv,node){const R=mv.rb,cfg=node.rb;if(!R||!cfg||!RB3.on)return null;const c0=v.c2;{const sb=rbSibYield3(v,mv,node);if(sb)return sb}

   const dn=rbMod2(R.a0-I.th)*R.Rc;if(dn<I.hl+c0.hl+14-I.post){RB3.n.nearYield++;return'rb-yield'}}}catch(e){}

/* 5 · an exit that holds one vehicle: nobody enters the roundabout behind a hotel / emergency vehicle that leaves by that exit */
function rbFleetOnWay3(m,to){   // the path of this vehicle runs along the lane `to` (between the ring and its stop line) within the next 44 m

function rbFleetAhead3(v,mv,node){if(!RB3.on)return null;const to=mv.to,R=node.rb;if(corridorCapacity2(to)>=2*(v.c2.len+CORE2.GAP)+30)return null;

/* 6 · שני נתיבי כניסה של אותה זרוע (שדרת המרכז בכיכר הכפר, 2+2) נכנסים לנתיב סיבוב אחד. המקור שהוכח (rb/tools/q_rb_merge.js, ‏72 תזמונים): רכב בנתיב

// ---- live train status for the phone / HUD ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function raTrain(){return rlTrain('FRT-1')}
function raAirRunIndex(){const T=raTrain();return T&&!T.err?T.runs.findIndex(r=>r.stop==='airport'):-1}
function raStatus(now=performance.now()){   // GATE-76 S3: the train at the terminal, or the next one (FRT-1 on T1, FRT-4 on T2)
 if(RA_SUSPENDED)return{ok:false,state:'suspended',label:'מסוף מושבת'};let best=null;
 for(const D of RA_TRAINS){const T=rlTrain(D.id);if(!T||T.err)continue;const k=T.runs.findIndex(r=>r.stop==='airport');if(k<0)continue;
  const S=rlState(T,now),R=T.runs[k],tt=now/1000+T.off,cyc=Math.floor(tt/T.cycle),tin=tt-cyc*T.cycle,arr=R.t0+R.tm,dep=R.tEnd,pas='פס '+D.lane;let s;
  if(S.k===k&&!S.moving)s={ok:true,state:'at-terminal',train:D.id,label:D.id+' ב'+pas+' · פריקה וטעינה · יציאה בעוד '+Math.ceil(dep-tin)+' שנ׳',left:dep-tin,cyc,rank:0};
  else if(S.k===k)s={ok:true,state:'arriving',train:D.id,label:D.id+' בדרך ל'+pas+' · הגעה בעוד '+Math.ceil(arr-tin)+' שנ׳',eta:arr-tin,cyc,rank:1+(arr-tin)/1e4};
  else{const eta=(tin<arr?arr-tin:T.cycle-tin+arr);s={ok:true,state:'away',train:D.id,label:'הרכבת הבאה ('+D.id+', '+pas+') בעוד '+Math.floor(eta/60)+':'+String(Math.floor(eta%60)).padStart(2,'0')+' דק׳',eta,cyc,rank:2+eta/1e4}}
  if(!best||s.rank<best.rank)best=s}
 return best||{ok:false,state:'suspended',label:'אין רכבת שדה'}
}
function raTrainLine(){const s=raStatus();return s.ok?s.label:'—'}
